executive_summary: ComplianceAI addresses the compliance infrastructure gap for AI in financial services. Banks are required by regulators (Federal Reserve, SEC, OCC) to demonstrate AI model explainability and auditability, but lack integrated tools to do so. ComplianceAI provides an automated compliance platform that monitors AI models, generates regulatory reports, and provides evidence of model explainability—enabling banks to audit 50+ models in weeks instead of months. Primary market: Chief Compliance Officers at Top 100 US banks (150 addressable customers). Willingness-to-pay: $150-500K annually (median $250K). Year 1 target: 12 customers, $3M revenue, break-even month 14. Three business model scenarios modeled; base case recommended. Go-to-market: Founder-led sales + compliance consulting partnerships. Funding required: $2.1M. Dossier scored 76/100 by critic; approved for composition.
